title: ee.config_explain.v1
description: Self-explaining config block for `ee config explain <key>`: what a setting affects at runtime, its effective value, the layer that set it (cli|environment|project|user|default), its valid range, an honest runtime status (active|forward_looking|inert), and a truth-in-labeling caveat when the name could mislead (e.g. search.semantic_weight). Optionally carries advisory config-lint findings. See bd-2vq2z.15.

category.description: Coarse grouping category (search, pack, storage, mesh, ...).

effect.description: What the knob affects at runtime, in one sentence.

status.description: Honest runtime status: active (wired now), forward_looking (parsed but not yet wired), or inert (no effect given other settings).

caveat.description: Truth-in-labeling caveat when the key name could mislead, else null.

effectiveValue.description: The current effective value rendered as a string, or null when unset.

sourceLayer.description: Which config layer supplied the effective value.

lintFindings.description: Advisory config-lint findings relevant to this key. Advisory only; never degrades health.

code.description: Stable machine code for the finding class.

key.description: The config key the finding concerns.

severity.description: Always advisory: config-lint never flips core health.
